evidence.evidenceSummary: Extensive user research, prototype results, and market analysis support this PRD.

knownFacts: 12 of 15 interviewed users confirmed the pain point.
Prototype reduced task time by 62% in a controlled test.
assumptions: The prototype result generalises to a broader user base.
Pricing model of $29/month is acceptable to the target segment.
unknowns: Enterprise upgrade path is not yet explored.
researchNeeded: Pricing sensitivity survey with 50 target users.
Security audit of the data processing pipeline.

riskNotes: Competitor X launched a similar feature last month.
API dependency on third-party OCR service introduces availability risk.

prd.problemStatement: Small business owners spend too much time on manual data entry instead of serving customers. Existing solutions are either too expensive or too complex for non-technical users.
targetUsers: Freelance bookkeepers managing up to 20 clients
goals: Reduce data entry time by 50% within the first month of use.
Achieve 90% accuracy on automated field classification.
nonGoals: Enterprise ERP integration is out of scope.
Real-time collaboration is out of scope for v1.
Mobile native app is out of scope.
prd.scope: Manual data entry automation for small service businesses, focusing on invoice, receipt, and timesheet processing.
userJourneys: User uploads a scanned invoice; system extracts fields; user confirms or corrects; data is saved.
User connects email inbox; system auto-detects receipts; user reviews weekly summary.
functionalRequirements: REQ-001: Upload scanned documents via drag-and-drop.
REQ-002: Extract key fields (date, amount, vendor) from documents.
REQ-003: Export extracted data to CSV.
successCriteria: Users complete data entry tasks in under 10 minutes per day.
Net Promoter Score above 30 after 30 days.
acceptanceCriteria: All REQ-00x items pass manual and automated tests.
No data loss on concurrent uploads.
risks: OCR accuracy degrades on low-quality scans.
User onboarding drop-off if initial setup takes more than 5 minutes.
openQuestions: Should we support handwriting recognition in v1?
Should we offer a free tier with limited documents per month?
